incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: Serving runtime degraded in us-west-2 — high error rate on model-load/warmup for model=redwood-v2-small-quant. Trigger: 15% request failures over 3m. Severity: P1. Paging oncall.
oncall-bot: Paging @Priya Nair (oncall) — please ack and triage. Link to incident: https://redwood.internal/incidents/3851236789
Priya Nair: acked. seeing repeated node flaps on pool gpu-pool-12, containers OOMing while deserializing artifacts during warmup. grabbing logs now.
Ben Cho: any customer impact noted? I see spike in 502/503s in front-door metrics for that region.
Priya Nair: yes: ~12% of requests to the hosted API returned 5xx for models pinned to redwood-v2-small-quant in us-west-2. Batching queues backed up, tail latency spiked. customer-impact: intermittent failures, some timeouts on LLM completion.
Maya SRE: logs show recurring error: 
```
E: cuda driver call failed: cudaErrorIllegalAddress: invalid device pointer
E: during model deserialization: checksum mismatch on sharded artifact shard_4.pt
E: fallback: compile step timed out after 120s for kernel selection
```
Also saw container restart loops (OOM at load) with kernel panic traces on kernel logs. suspect corrupted shard + memory pressure triggers illegal address in cuBLAS.
Javier Rivera: could be a bad artifact in the model bundle. Any recent artifact pushes? @Ben?
Ben Cho: no deploys in the last 24h for that model. Artifact metadata hash shows a mismatch between S3 and cache. S3 reports md5=aa12.., node cache reports aa13.. — maybe partial upload or disk corruption during replication.
Priya Nair: mitigation plan: 1) remove faulty nodes from rotation (mark pool gpu-pool-12 draining), 2) scale up spare pool (gpu-pool-9) and start warmup to absorb traffic, 3) instruct runtime to route to quantized-fallback model redwood-v2-small-q4_0 if warmup failures continue, 4) invalidate local artifact cache and re-pull from S3 (with integrity check).
Maya SRE: executing step 1 and 2 now. draining nodes and adding 4 extra instances to gpu-pool-9. ETA for new warmups ~90s.
oncall-bot: Handoff: @Priya (current) -> @Ben (next) in 13m. Please include rollback token and customer impact summary in the handoff message.
Priya Nair: performing cache invalidation on affected nodes: `ssh node-12-0 'rm -rf /var/cache/redwood/artifacts/* && systemctl restart redwood-runtime'` — kicking the restart and re-pull.
Ben Cho: watching logs. re-pull succeeded on two nodes, checksum intact. one node failed with IO error while writing shard_4.pt: "write: no space left on device" — filling up /dev/nvme0n1 on warmup. cleaning temporary dirs.
Maya SRE: temp cleanup done, re-warmup triggered. also adjusted compile timeout to 240s for this model temporarily to avoid spurious compile-timeouts during kernel selection (`/etc/redwood/runtime.d/models.d/redwood-v2-small-quant.conf: compile_timeout=240`).
Priya Nair: traffic now routing to gpu-pool-9; error rate falling to 2.6% in last minute. Streaming latency back to baseline for most requests. continuing to monitor. customer-impact note: affected customers experienced 10-20s extra tail latency or 5xx until warmups reprovisioned; no data exposure.
Javier Rivera: recommend postmortem actions: 1) add artifact integrity gating on deploy (verify full shard checksum on S3), 2) add disk-space alert for warmup nodes, 3) make compile-timeout model-configurable with safer defaults, 4) automatic fallback policy to quantized variant when warmup failures exceed 5%.
Priya Nair: agreed. I'll draft the incident ticket and assign follow-ups. current status: mitigated (routing + cache invalidate + node cleanup). next: handoff to Ben for monitoring and customer comms.
oncall-bot: Handoff acked: @Ben Cho now oncall owner for this incident. Please update status channel when closed.
Ben Cho: ack. will keep watching for 30m, then close if stable. adding short blurb for customers: "We experienced a transient model warmup failure in us-west-2 causing intermittent 5xx responses. Root cause: corrupted artifact shard + node disk pressure causing OOMs during deserialization; we invalidated caches and reprovisioned warmup capacity. Service is recovering; follow-up actions scheduled." :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident P1 -> mitigated (status updated). Timeline and logs linked: https://redwood.internal/incidents/3851236789/timeline
